versions.changelog:
Initial release of Isekai Character Generator.

- Generate unique isekai anime characters and light novel protagonists in popular Niji-style anime aesthetics.
- Supports custom prompts, various image aspect ratios, and style inheritance via reference image.
- Integrates with the Neta AI image generation API (token required).
- Perfect for fanart, OC design, manga concepts, and character sheets.
- Simple command-line interface with quick start instructions.
